---
name: word-count
description: Counts words in text files and writes a JSON report. Use when the user asks how long their documents are.
---

# Word Count

- Counts the words in every `.txt` file in a folder.
- Sorts the results in descending order by word count.
- Writes the results to `report.json` in the same folder.

Run `python scripts/count.py <folder>`.
